explanations.10: The question mark before .href (called optional chaining) safely accesses href even if faviconLink is null, preventing an error.
explanations.14: The \u{1F440} is Unicode escape syntax that renders as an emoji (the eyes emoji) in the page title.
explanations.22: The 'visibilitychange' event fires whenever the browser tab becomes hidden or visible, letting us detect when the user switches away.
explanations.23: The return statement here creates a cleanup function that removes the event listener when the component unmounts, preventing memory leaks.
